goals.objective:
Implement MVP phases 3-5 of the collaborative voxel editor: a Bevy 0.20.1 3D voxel renderer with click-to-place/erase, a WebSocket client that syncs voxel edits in real-time between multiple client instances via the shared server, and a Mantine 9 UI with color picker, toolbar, roster, and connection status – all running as a standalone Bevy application (no Tauri).

== Success criteria ==
- `cargo check --workspace` passes with zero errors
- `cargo test --workspace` passes with all tests green
- The Bevy app compiles and can be launched without panic (user visually confirms rendering on a display)
- Two client instances connect to the same server and exchange VoxelEdit messages in real-time (verified via server log output)
- Mantine UI dev server starts and the components render without errors

== Boundaries ==
In scope:
- Phase 3: Bevy 0.20.1 voxel rendering in the game crate (Mesh3d cuboids, camera, orbit, WASD, click raycasting, spawn/remove sync)
- Phase 4: WebSocket client in the game crate (tokio + tokio-tungstenite) – join, snapshot apply, VoxelEdit send/receive, roster, heartbeat
- Phase 5: Mantine 9 React components (ColorPicker, Toolbar, RosterPanel, ConnectionPanel, CommStatus) – built and importable, dev server running
- Two-client integration test confirming real-time sync

Out of scope:
- Phase 6 (Tauri wrapping) – deferred
- Persistence to disk, authentication, multi-scene, physics
- No changes to server authority model or warren-protocol crate
- No changes to the existing server crate

== Constraints ==
- All coding subagents must use model ollama/qwen3-coder
- Main orchestrator stays on ollama/qwen3.8:27b for planning, coordination, and review
- Target Bevy 0.20.1 (latest stable)
- No external voxel crates (bevy_voxel is a placeholder)
- Use existing warren-protocol crate for all wire types
- No Tauri; the Bevy app runs as a standalone window
- Do not modify the server crate's public API
- Bevy and async runtime must coexist (separate thread for WebSocket)

== Verification contract ==
- `cargo check --workspace` – 0 errors
- `cargo test --workspace` – all pass
- `cargo build -p warren-game --release` – compiles without panic
- Mantine: `bun run dev` starts the dev server without errors
- Two-client sync: server logs show two peers joining and exchanging VoxelEdit messages
- Re-read MVP_PLAN.md and confirm all Phase 3-5 items are addressed

== If blocked ==
Stop and ask the user. Do not attempt to work around blockers by changing scope or using a different model.
